name: CopySell AI
desc: SaaS for generating marketplace listings with AI
inspiration: I wanted to explore building a full SaaS with artificial intelligence, combining AI-powered content generation with a plans system, credits, and an admin dashboard.

name: Sprint Pro
desc: SaaS task management platform with Kanban, organization permissions and reports
inspiration: I wanted to build a team management platform from scratch, with a decoupled frontend and backend architecture, JWT authentication, multi-tenant control and real features like invites, Kanban drag and drop and an online presence system.

name: Smart Catalog
desc: Product catalog management and analysis with AI-powered insights
inspiration: I built this to understand how to create a complete B2B application, with company-based authentication, an analytics dashboard and AI to generate insights about a product portfolio.

name: Cardápio Pro
desc: Digital menu for food and retail businesses
inspiration: This project was inspired by my desire to enter the SaaS world and understand how to create, develop, publish and manage a SaaS product from end to end.

name: ToDo React
desc: Task list app — my very first React project
inspiration: This was my first project built with React. Through it I took my first steps with the library, learning about componentization, state management and the logic behind creating and removing tasks.

name: Portfolio
desc: My personal portfolio built from scratch
inspiration: I wanted to create my own portfolio to present my projects and skills in a professional way, while practicing componentization and responsive design.
